tags.name: sds-combobox
tags.description: Enhances a native text input and suggestion list with accessible combobox keyboard behavior. One direct child labeled text or search input. One direct child ul with li options; author it hidden for server rendering. Rich li options may use a nonempty data-label for the input's selected text and application-owned data attributes for identity. Optional direct child output for an accessible empty-result message; data-empty-message overrides the default text.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: Automatic filtering of option text, or application-managed results. Default: automatic.

attributes.name: keep-open
attributes.description: Keep matching suggestions available after selecting an option while writing its text to the input. Default: false.

tags.name: sds-dropdown
tags.description: Enhances a direct child button and menu with Popover positioning and menu keyboard behavior. One direct child button trigger. One direct child menu or Popover surface.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the menu is open. Default: false.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred logical floating placement. Default: block-end-start.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Nonnegative offset in CSS pixels. Default: 5.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Recipe or overlay width. Default: md.

attributes.name: hide-caret
attributes.description: Hides the visual caret. Default: false.

tags.name: sds-popover
tags.description: Enhances a direct child button and rich Popover surface with delayed hover and focus behavior. One direct child button trigger. One direct child rich-content Popover surface.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the popover is open. Default: false.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred logical floating placement. Default: block-end-start.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Nonnegative offset in CSS pixels. Default: 9.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Recipe or overlay width. Default: md.

tags.name: sds-tabs
tags.description: Coordinates a tab list and one panel per tab. A direct child tab-list container with button or link children. One direct child panel for every tab.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value of the selected tab; an explicit value takes precedence. Default: aria-selected tab or first enabled tab.

attributes.name: activation
attributes.description: Whether focus automatically selects a tab. Default: automatic.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout or interaction orientation. Default: horizontal.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Visual scale. Default: md.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Semantic color intent. Default: accent.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Visual treatment. Default: folder.

tags.name: sds-tooltip
tags.description: Enhances a direct child trigger and short description with accessible tooltip behavior. One direct child trigger. One direct child text description.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred logical floating placement. Default: block-start.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Tooltip width. Default: sm.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Nonnegative offset in CSS pixels. Default: 6.

tags.name: sds-toast
tags.description: A timed or persistent notification. A direct child strong title and message content are recommended. A close control is needed for persistent notifications.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the toast is visible. Default: false.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Semantic color intent. Default: accent.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Positive duration in milliseconds. Default: 5000.

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: Disables automatic dismissal. Default: false.
